> **Pipeline step 04 — residual diagnostics (DHARMa).**
>
> **Purpose.** Simulation-based (DHARMa) residual checks for every reported fit: KS uniformity,
> dispersion, outliers (bootstrap) and zero inflation, with a 2×2 panel per model and a summary
> table. Knit once per model set by changing `SURVEY` in the `file-index` chunk
> (`"tps"`, `"edsm"` or `"tps_fl"`).
>
> **Inputs.** the saved fits for the chosen set and the CSV they were fitted to.
> **Outputs.** `<fit dir>/DHARMa_diagnostics/<fit>_2x2.png` and `<prefix>dharma_summary.csv`.
>
> **Cost.** ~1 min per TPS model, longer for EDSM (random effects, 4,241 rows).

```{r project-root, include=FALSE}
# Every path in this notebook (data/, fits_*/, output_figs/, cache/) is relative to the
# REPOSITORY ROOT, not to this file's sub-folder. Walk up from the working directory to the
# folder holding the .Rproj file, and make knitr (and RStudio's chunk-by-chunk notebook
# mode) run every chunk from there. Base R only -- no extra package needed.
find_repo_root <- function(path = getwd()) {
  p <- normalizePath(path)
  while (!length(list.files(p, pattern = "\\.Rproj$"))) {
    if (dirname(p) == p) stop("No .Rproj file found above ", path)
    p <- dirname(p)
  }
  p
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = find_repo_root())
```
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(brms)
library(DHARMa)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(patchwork)
library(kableExtra)
library(lubridate)
```

## File index

```{r file-index}
# Which reported model set to diagnose. Knit once per set:
#   "tps"    -> TPS catch,       fits_tps_wq_Vfix/fit_tps_wq0..13      (PSIS-LOO set)
#   "edsm"   -> EDSM catch,      fits_edsm_Vfix/fit_edsm_0..21         (grouped K-fold set)
#   "tps_fl" -> TPS fork length, fits_tps_fl_kfold/fit_tps_fl_1..19    (LOSO K-fold set)
SURVEY <- "tps"

cfg <- switch(SURVEY,
  tps    = list(dir = "fits_tps_wq_Vfix",  root = "fit_tps_wq",  nums = 0:13,
                dat = "data/tow_12_6_tps_wq_nona.csv"),
  edsm   = list(dir = "fits_edsm_Vfix",    root = "fit_edsm_",   nums = 0:21,
                dat = "data/tow_12_6_edsm_wq_nona.csv"),
  tps_fl = list(dir = "fits_tps_fl_kfold", root = "fit_tps_fl_", nums = 1:19,
                dat = "data/tps_forklength_data.csv"),
  stop("SURVEY must be 'tps', 'edsm' or 'tps_fl'"))

fit_dir       <- cfg$dir          # directory containing the fits
fit_root      <- cfg$root         # filename prefix (before the number)
fit_filenames <- paste0(fit_dir, "/", fit_root, cfg$nums, ".rds")

# Path to the original data CSV used to fit the models (deep-dive section only)
dat_path <- cfg$dat

# Number of DHARMa simulations — used identically in batch AND deep-dive
# so table p-values match plot p-values. Higher = more precise but slower.
n_sim_dharma <- 1000

# Only keep files that actually exist on disk
fit_filenames_exist <- fit_filenames[file.exists(fit_filenames)]

cat("Fits found on disk:\n")
cat(paste(" ", fit_filenames_exist), sep = "\n")
```

## Batch diagnostics

Run DHARMa for every available fit, store pass/flag results in a summary
table, and write PNG diagnostics into `<fit_dir>/DHARMa_diagnostics/`.

```{r batch-diagnostics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── output directory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

diag_base <- file.path(fit_dir, "DHARMa_diagnostics")
if (!dir.exists(diag_base)) dir.create(diag_base, recursive = TRUE)

# ── helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#' Run DHARMa diagnostics for one brms fit and return a one-row summary tibble.
#'
#' @param fit       A fitted brms model.
#' @param fit_label Character label used in filenames and table (e.g. "fit_edsm_8").
#' @param out_dir   Directory where PNGs are written.
#' @param n_sim     Number of DHARMa simulations (higher = more precise).
#'
#' @return A one-row tibble with test statistics and pass/flag indicators.
run_dharma_diagnostics <- function(fit, fit_label, diag_base, n_sim = 1000) {

  # ── simulate residuals ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  set.seed(123)
  sim <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = fit, n = n_sim, plot = FALSE)

  # ── individual tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  t_unif   <- testUniformity(sim,    plot = FALSE)
  t_disp   <- testDispersion(sim,    plot = FALSE)
  t_out    <- testOutliers(sim,      plot = FALSE, type = "bootstrap")
  t_zin    <- testZeroInflation(sim, plot = FALSE)

  # ── summarise ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pval_flag <- function(p, alpha = 0.05) if (is.na(p) || p < alpha) "FLAG" else "pass"

  row <- tibble(
    fit          = fit_label,
    ks_stat      = round(t_unif$statistic, 4),
    ks_p         = round(t_unif$p.value,   4),
    ks_flag      = pval_flag(t_unif$p.value),
    disp_ratio   = round(t_disp$statistic, 4),
    disp_p       = round(t_disp$p.value,   4),
    disp_flag    = pval_flag(t_disp$p.value),
    # statistic is count of outliers; divide by nObs to get fraction
    outlier_frac = round(as.numeric(t_out$statistic) / length(sim$scaledResiduals), 4),
    outlier_p    = round(t_out$p.value,   4),
    outlier_flag = pval_flag(t_out$p.value),
    zi_ratio     = round(t_zin$statistic, 4),
    zi_p         = round(t_zin$p.value,   4),
    zi_flag      = pval_flag(t_zin$p.value),
    any_flag     = if (any(c(ks_flag, disp_flag, outlier_flag, zi_flag) == "FLAG"))
                     "FLAG" else "pass"
  )

  # ── 2x2 diagnostic plot saved flat into diag_base ────────────────────────
  png(file.path(diag_base, paste0(fit_label, "_2x2.png")),
      width = 1800, height = 1400, res = 200)
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2), oma = c(0, 1, 2, 1))
  plotQQunif(sim)
  plotResiduals(sim)
  testDispersion(sim)
  testZeroInflation(sim)
  mtext(fit_label, outer = TRUE, cex = 1.2)
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
  dev.off()

  row
}

# ── batch loop ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

results_list <- vector("list", length(fit_filenames_exist))

for (i in seq_along(fit_filenames_exist)) {
  fpath <- fit_filenames_exist[i]
  flabel <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fpath))   # e.g. "fit_edsm_8"

  message(sprintf("[%d/%d] Running diagnostics for %s ...",
                  i, length(fit_filenames_exist), flabel))

  fit <- readRDS(fpath)

  results_list[[i]] <- tryCatch(
    run_dharma_diagnostics(fit, flabel, diag_base, n_sim = n_sim_dharma),
    error = function(e) {
      warning(sprintf("Diagnostics failed for %s: %s", flabel, conditionMessage(e)))
      tibble(fit = flabel, any_flag = "ERROR",
             ks_stat = NA, ks_p = NA, ks_flag = NA,
             disp_ratio = NA, disp_p = NA, disp_flag = NA,
             outlier_frac = NA, outlier_p = NA, outlier_flag = NA,
             zi_ratio = NA, zi_p = NA, zi_flag = NA)
    }
  )

  rm(fit)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

diag_summary <- bind_rows(results_list)
```

## Summary table – at-a-glance

Rows flagged `FLAG` warrant closer inspection in the deep-dive section below.

```{r summary-table}
# Colour-code in HTML output
flag_cols <- c("ks_flag", "disp_flag", "outlier_flag", "zi_flag", "any_flag")

diag_summary |>
  mutate(across(all_of(flag_cols),
                ~ cell_spec(.x, color = if_else(.x == "FLAG", "red", "black"),
                            bold = .x == "FLAG"))) |>
  knitr::kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE, align = "c") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

```{r save-summary}
summary_file <- file.path(diag_base, paste0(fit_root, "dharma_summary.csv"))
readr::write_csv(diag_summary, summary_file)
message("Summary written to ", summary_file)
```

---

## Deep-dive diagnostics for flagged fits

Re-load a specific fit and run targeted follow-up tests.  Edit `flag_fit` to
the label you want to inspect (e.g. `"fit_edsm_8"`), then run this chunk.

```{r deep-dive-setup, eval=FALSE}
flag_fit  <- paste0(fit_root, cfg$nums[1])   # <- change to the fit you want, e.g. "fit_edsm_9"
flag_path <- file.path(fit_dir, paste0(flag_fit, ".rds"))

stopifnot(file.exists(flag_path))
fit_dd <- readRDS(flag_path)

set.seed(123)
sim_dd <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = fit_dd, n = n_sim_dharma, plot = FALSE)

# Deep-dive outputs go in a per-fit subfolder under diag_base
dd_dir <- file.path(diag_base, flag_fit)
if (!dir.exists(dd_dir)) dir.create(dd_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

### 2x2 summary plot

```{r dd-2x2, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, eval=FALSE}
png(file.path(dd_dir, paste0(flag_fit, "_dd_2x2.png")), width = 1800, height = 1400, res = 200)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), oma = c(0, 1, 2, 1))
plotQQunif(sim_dd)
plotResiduals(sim_dd)
testDispersion(sim_dd)
testZeroInflation(sim_dd)
mtext(paste(flag_fit, "– deep dive"), outer = TRUE, cex = 1.2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
dev.off()

par(mfrow = c(2, 2), oma = c(0, 1, 2, 1))
plotQQunif(sim_dd)
plotResiduals(sim_dd)
testDispersion(sim_dd)
testZeroInflation(sim_dd)
mtext(paste(flag_fit, "– deep dive"), outer = TRUE, cex = 1.2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

### Outliers

```{r dd-outliers, eval=FALSE}
png(file.path(dd_dir, paste0(flag_fit, "_dd_outliers.png")), width = 900, height = 800, res = 150)
testOutliers(sim_dd, type = "bootstrap")
dev.off()
testOutliers(sim_dd, type = "bootstrap")
```

### Residuals vs each predictor

Swap in the actual data object and predictor names relevant to your model.

```{r dd-residuals-by-predictor, eval=FALSE}
dat <- readr::read_csv(dat_path) |>
  mutate(SampleDate = lubridate::mdy(SampleDate))

predictors_to_check <- c("Year", "Julian_day", "Temperature", "Turbidity",
                          "StationCode", "Secchi")

for (pred in predictors_to_check) {
  if (pred %in% names(dat)) {
    plotResiduals(sim_dd, form = dat[[pred]], xlab = pred,
                  main = paste(flag_fit, "–", pred))
  }
}
```

### Temporal / spatial autocorrelation

```{r dd-autocorrelation, eval=FALSE}
# dat must already be loaded (run the residuals-by-predictor chunk first)
testSpatialAutocorrelation(sim_dd,
                            x = dat$Longitude,
                            y = dat$Latitude)

testTemporalAutocorrelation(sim_dd, time = dat$SampleDate)  # SampleDate already as.Date()
```
